name: rolepod-wplab
description: WordPress operations toolkit for AI coding agents — 62 MCP tools + 12 lean Rolepod-pattern skills (/wp-pair-setup, /wp-connect, /wp-health-check, /wp-content, /wp-edit-design, /wp-edit-plugin, /wp-scaffold, /wp-introspect, /wp-diagnose, /wp-migrate, /wp-changes, /wp-execute-php) + /wp-full alias. 4 connection kinds (local / REST + App Password / SSH / Docker). Default-safe wp-cli + REST + scoped fs out of the box; the rolepod-wp WordPress plugin unlocks execute-php + runtime introspection + one-click pair setup.

interface.shortDescription: WordPress operations toolkit — 62 MCP tools, 11 skills, 4 connection kinds, opt-in rolepod-wp plugin for execute-php + one-click pair.
interface.longDescription: rolepod-wplab ships an MCP server with 62 tools and 11 user-invocable skills. Connect any WordPress install via local filesystem, HTTPS REST + App Password, SSH, or Docker. Default-safe surface covers wp-cli (allow-listed), REST CRUD, scoped fs writes, page-builder adapters (Elementor / Divi / Oxygen / Bricks), SEO + WPML write, WooCommerce, ACF, forms (Gravity / CF7 / WPForms), cron, cache, mail-test, full site clone, backup, diagnose, scaffold (block / plugin / theme / pattern). Install the optional rolepod-wp WordPress plugin to unlock execute-php (AST-screened on both sides), runtime introspection, and the one-click 'Generate setup prompt' wizard that pairs the AI in 30 seconds.
defaultPrompt: Use /wp-pair-setup with this pair token to connect my WordPress site.
Use /wp-health-check to confirm the target is reachable + companion is present.
Use /wp-audit-security to scan the connected site for outdated core/plugins/themes + weak admins.
